entries.name: Winnowing

description.from: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within range take 4 additional damage whenever they take physical damage. This spirit dies after 30...150 seconds.
description.to: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within range take 4 additional damage whenever they take physical damage. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.

concise.from: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...150 second lifespan). Increases physical damage by +4 for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.
concise.to: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Increases physical damage by +4 for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

notes: Winnowing: Feb 9, 2026 update (duration to 30-240) was never applied locally

entries.name: Primal Echoes

description.to: Create a level 1...10 Spirit. For non-Spirit creatures within its range, Signets cost 10 Energy to use. This Spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.

concise.from: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...150 second lifespan). Signets cost 10 energy for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

entries.name: Predatory Season

description.from: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all healing is reduced by 20%. If any of your attacks hit, you gain 5 Health. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
description.to: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all healing is reduced by 20%. If any of your attacks hit, you gain 5 Health. This spirit dies after 30...150 seconds.

concise.from: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). Creatures in range receive 20% less from healing. Creatures gain 5 health each time they hit with an attack. Does not affect spirits.
concise.to: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...150 second lifespan). Creatures in range receive 20% less from healing. Creatures gain 5 health each time they hit with an attack. Does not affect spirits.

notes: Predatory Season: Feb 5, 2026 notes announced 30...240 but the change never landed in game (wiki infobox, actively maintained, still shows 30...150); revert

entries.name: Energizing Wind

entries.name: Quickening Zephyr

description.from: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all skills recharge twice as fast and cost 30% more of the base Energy to cast. This spirit dies after 15...45 seconds.

entries.name: Nature's Renewal

description.from: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For 30...150 seconds, enchantments and hexes cast by non-spirit creatures in range take twice as long to cast, and it costs twice as much Energy to maintain enchantments. This spirit dies after 30...150 seconds.
description.to: Create a level 1...10 spirit. For 30...240 seconds, enchantments and hexes cast by non-spirit creatures in range take twice as long to cast, and it costs twice as much Energy to maintain enchantments. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.

concise.from: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...150 second lifespan). For creatures in range, enchantments and Hexes <sic/> take twice as long to cast and it costs twice as much Energy to maintain enchantments. Does not affect spirits.
concise.to: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). For creatures in range, enchantments and Hexes <sic/> take twice as long to cast and it costs twice as much Energy to maintain enchantments. Does not affect spirits.

notes: Nature's Renewal: Feb 9, 2026 update (duration to 30-240) was never applied locally; applies to both effect duration and spirit lifespan per wiki

entries.name: Tranquility

description.from: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Enchantments cast by non-spirit creatures within its range expire 20...50% faster. This spirit dies after 30...120 seconds.
description.to: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Enchantments cast by non-spirit creatures within its range expire 20...50% faster. This spirit dies after 15...120 seconds.

concise.from: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...120 second lifespan). Enchantments expire 20...50% faster on creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.
concise.to: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (15...120 second lifespan). Enchantments expire 20...50% faster on creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

notes: Tranquility: Feb 5, 2026 notes said 30...120 but the in-game implementation (per actively maintained wiki infobox) is 15...120
